q: Puh-lease! I went to a bar mitzvah once. That doesn't make me Jewish.
1997, Don Roos, The Opposite of Sex, spoken by Lucia (Lisa Kudrow):

“Miss Abby, you walk wif us, puhlease?” Hank's words invited her along and wrangled her heart with little effort. She opened the door to the sight of both boys, faces pouting. “Puhlease,” Will added, a wink the only difference between the two.
2013, Linda S. Glaz, Always, Abby, Harlequin, →ISBN, pages 75–76:
He was sporting his inky Italian moustaches glistering with Vaseline and perfume. Puh! How uncommentable!
2010, John P. Anderson, Joyce's Finnegans Wake: The Curse of Kabbalah, volume 4, page 82:
‘Come on,’ she says to the entranced child, ‘downstairs and help us collect some puha to go with them.’
